purpose: A provenance-controlled subset of open benchmark designs and locally available WebTestPilot cases. It records what is adapted, what remains reference-only, and the gates required before any case enters confirmatory collection.

reuse_policy.copy_policy: Do not copy external task instances into the public repository unless the source license and attribution permit it. Prefer local task blueprints and record source paths/URLs.
reuse_policy.confirmatory_rule: Reference-only or blocked cases cannot contribute confirmatory estimates. Pilot failures remain in the ledger and are not silently discarded.
